TestScyllaManagerClusterMgmt::test_addin.relevance: Manager still validates connectivity on cluster add (scylla-manager pkg/service/cluster PutCluster -> ValidateHostsConnectivity, ErrNoValidKnownHost), so the intended behavior is live. It is not reachable here: ccm ScyllaCluster.stop also stops the manager server when skip_manager_server is False, the default for the main cluster (https://github.com/scylladb/scylla-ccm/blob/c10ff2f260e717d7ec3e3ec745793d5f2664c7ac/ccmlib/scylla_cluster.py#L239-L244; same since ccm 1095408, 2018), and the manager's backend DB is node1 of the same cluster. The first sctool call in add_cluster (version, dtest_scylla_manager.py:800) fails with 'dial tcp <node1>:5080: connect: connection refused' from sctool to the manager server; ccm raises on the non-zero exit and SCTool.run wraps it into ScyllaManagerError (dtest_scylla_manager.py:838), which the assertion matches.
